newsitem.title: CANADA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SENATORS BEAT WHALERS.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SENATORS BEAT WHALERS.

text.p: Radek Bonk's goal with 5:23 left in the second period snapped a tie and Daniel Alfredsson had a goal and an assist as the Ottawa Senators beat the Hartford Whalers 4-2 on Sunday.
Damian Rhodes made 25 saves for the Senators, who improved to 19-26-12 and bettered the club mark set last season.
Kevin Haller and Kevin Dineen scored for Hartford, and Sean Burke made 27 saves.
At Florida, Darren McCarty assisted on the tying goal and scored the game-winner to lead the Detroit Red Wings to a 4-2 victory over the Florida Panthers.
Steve Yzerman scored his 16th goal on a rebound from McCarty's shot as Detroit tied the score 2-2 with 6:36 left in the second period.

In Buffalo, Donald Audette and Jason Dawe each scored two goals and Dominik Hasek made 31 saves as the Buffalo Sabres extended their unbeaten streak to nine games with a 6-2 victory over the floundering San Jose Sharks.
Jeff Friesen and Owen Nolan scored for San Jose, which lost its fourth straight game and finished 0-4-1 on a five-game road trip.
"The same old story four shots, two goals," San Jose coach Al Sims said. "All of a sudden we're struggling uphill again."
In Pittsburgh, Trent Klatt scored two goals and Garth Snow made 28 saves as the Philadelphia Flyers stopped a 14-game winless streak at Pittsburgh with a 6-2 victory over the Penguins.
After the Penguins took a 2-0 lead in the first period, Snow stopped 15 shots over the final two sessions as the Flyers won at Pittsburgh for the first time since 1990.
John LeClair, Rod Brind'Amour and John Druce each had a goal and an assist for the Flyers.
Jaromir Jagr and Chris Tamer scored for Pittsburgh, which lost its fourth straight game.
